result.summary: Updates the Qt dependency in the depends build system to 6.12.0 LTS and bumps the macOS SDK build requirement to 15.0. The minimum supported macOS runtime deployment target remains at 14.0.
result.problem: Bitcoin Core builds against an older Qt release that lacks upstream bug fixes and official platform support for newer macOS releases.
evidence: PR description: 'The new Qt 6.12 LTS contains many bug fixes and officially supports macOS 26.'
Commit eaa8d1f5a5: 'Qt 6.12 requires macOS 15 SDK or higher. See https://doc.qt.io/qt-6.12/macos.html.'
result.scope_notes: Touches depends build recipes, likely removing obsolete patches or build scripts for older Qt versions.
result.card: Updates the depends system to Qt 6.12.0 LTS and bumps the build requirement to macOS SDK 15.0 while preserving macOS 14.0 runtime compatibility. The update provides upstream Qt bug fixes and official support for newer macOS versions. Depends on PR #36592.
uncertainties: Diff is not available to verify which Qt modules, patches, or build flags are altered.

risk.why: Upgrading Qt and changing the macOS SDK changes release binary build environments and can introduce GUI rendering, event handling, or packaging regressions on supported operating systems.
